units.primary_behavior: Define typed pre-execution prerequisite and classification contracts.
units.acceptance_boundary: Schemas distinguish satisfied, unmet, ambiguous, stale, and invalid outcomes and reject authority or scope collapse.

units.primary_behavior: Classify a selected unit's prerequisite before Context Builder under an instrumented read/phase budget.
units.acceptance_boundary: Unmet/ambiguous/stale cases return a typed receipt without entering forbidden phases.

units.primary_behavior: Route one pre-execution prerequisite hop through Continuation Router.
units.acceptance_boundary: The router distinguishes prerequisite phase, performs at most one exact authorized owner dispatch, and preserves owner authority.

units.primary_behavior: Join the owner receipt, revalidate scope, and resume the same Task Session attempt once.
units.acceptance_boundary: A current owner receipt resumes at Context Builder once; stale, reused, or mismatched receipts block before mutation.

units.primary_behavior: Make Invoke Plan and Implementation Readiness advertise a prerequisite-consistent execution entry.
units.acceptance_boundary: Plans cannot claim Task Session is immediate when a prerequisite is unmet, and plan-once is reused for expected just-in-time material.

units.primary_behavior: Prove the complete entry route and synchronize validated generated packages.
units.acceptance_boundary: Synthetic and regression canaries pass, generated packages match canonical sources, and public scans find no private identifiers.
